  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

1Game servers (no launcher)
  Needs nEVR with its early load pass (BugSplat64.dll from the launcher's Beta
  channel or newer). EchoCombatContent.dll (in plugins\) serves the pack itself:
  no NvrContentOverlay needed.
  1. Copy plugins\* into bin\win10\plugins\ and content\ into bin\win10\ (the pack
     must end up in bin\win10\content\echocombat\, beside the plugins folder).
  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.

  2. Add to the plugins: list in _local\config.yaml (keep the rest of the file).
     EchoCombatContent first, with early: true (it must load before the game opens
     its data):
       - name: "EchoCombatContent"
         file: "EchoCombatContent.dll"
         enabled: true
         early: true
       - name: "DroneFix"
         file: "DroneFix.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "PowerBoost"
         file: "PowerBoost.dll"
         enabled: true
       - name: "VeilNet"
         file: "VeilNet.dll"
         enabled: true
     Take out an NvrContentOverlay entry if there is one (with it loaded,
     EchoCombatContent stays off).
  3. nEVR 6.17 and newer have their own copy of EchoCombat built in. Turn it off
     with this top-level block in the same config.yaml, or the plugins stand down
     and leave the game to it:
       combat:
         drone: false
         overcharge: false
         medigun: false
         veil: false
         match_control: false
         balance: false
  4. nEVR's run log should have a line tagged plugin=EchoCombatContent that says
     "serving the EchoCombat pack", a "Loaded:" line for each plugin, and (6.17)
     "feature off ... source=config" for each combat key above.
